heading: Boundary revision
lead: The boundaries of the park are revised to include approximately 600 additional acres.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was enacted as part of the National Parks and Recreation Act of 1978, and not as part of the Chesapeake and Ohio Canal Development Act which comprises this subchapter.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1980—Pub. L. 96–199 struck out proviso that additions to the park as authorized by this section shall not include any properties located between 30th Street and Thomas Jefferson Street in the northwest section of the District of Columbia.
